test_instructions: In PowerToys Settings, enable File Explorer add-ons for SVG Preview Pane and SVG thumbnails.

Open a folder containing several SVG files, enable the Preview pane, and move between the files twice. Verify previews render correctly on the first pass and are reused without blank or partially rendered output on the second pass.
Change the SVG preview background mode/color in Settings, reopen the same SVG, and verify the preview reflects the new settings rather than stale cached HTML.

Exercise the same SVG from multiple Explorer windows and verify previews/thumbnails remain correct; very large SVG output should render through the temporary fallback without leaving persistent transient files.
